answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by forcing every newcomer to lock a refundable bond in a shared lagoon of collateral for several weeks, then finish a slow peer-checked chore: tend a plot of yarrow whose daily growth is attested by randomly assigned neighbors. Only after that cooling-off window may the agent approach a reputation summit. Throwaway clones cannot afford the lockup or the waiting, so mass fake identities stay unprofitable.
